[[Aurora Glade (outpost)|Aurora Glade]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]].

==Getting There==
*From [[Ventari's Refuge]], head northwest, and then back east across [[Ettin's Back]]. Once you reach the eastern side of the map, avoid the turnoff to [[Dry Top]], and continue east and then north to [[Aurora Glade]].
*The quest [[Urgent Warning]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[Aurora Glade]]
**This mission is the twelfth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the third and final mission in the [[Maguuma Jungle]] region.
